player_prompt.intro:
Wee ni Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) katika mchezo wa Matching Pennies wa mizunguko {num_rounds}.
- Kila mzunguko, wasilisha [heads] au [tails] (au [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linapatana na la mpinzani wako, Mchezaji 0 anashinda mzunguko; vinginevyo Mchezaji 1 anashinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako kwa mfumo wa '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muundo usio sahihi; tafadhali wasilisha '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Match -> Mchezaji 0 anashinda
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Kutopatana -> Mchezaji 1 anashinda.

outcome.p0_wins: Ũla wakwatiwe nĩ mũisyo ũsu atindie aimasinda.
outcome.p1_wins: Ũla wakĩelekanilye na ĩthaũ yĩu aĩ ũla wakwatie masindano maingĩ.
